_comment: Climate inputs of the simulator (loaded by src/hvac_savings/model.py). The model is driven by the MEASURED TMYx hourly weather in experiments/weather/ (dry-bulb and dew-point temperature, pressure, global/direct/diffuse solar radiation) -- the same files the EnergyPlus benchmark reads. REP representative days per month (parameters.json) are sampled evenly through each month of the TMYx year and scaled to the month. Tg = ground-contact temperature under the ground-floor slab.
